questions.prompt: A multi-tenant Cosmos DB search endpoint runs queries for one tenant at a time. Which SDK query option helps route each request to a single logical partition?
questions.explanation: Scoping the query with the partition key limits routing to the intended partition.
options: Set consistency to strong on every request
Pass the tenant value as the partition key
Use a new CosmosClient for each request
Set the page size to one
questions.answer: Pass the tenant value as the partition key

questions.prompt: A newly deployed AKS container repeatedly exits. Which command retrieves the logs from the previous instance of the named container?
questions.explanation: The --previous flag fetches the terminated container instance's logs, which can reveal startup errors.
questions.answer: kubectl logs POD -c CONTAINER --previous

questions.prompt: An AKS API loads its model for several minutes. The liveness check keeps restarting it before initialization completes. Which probe is intended for this startup period?
questions.explanation: A startup probe delays liveness and readiness checks until startup succeeds, giving slow initialization its own budget.
questions.answer: Startup probe

questions.prompt: An engineer needs distinct service names for the API and embedding worker in a shared telemetry backend. Which OpenTelemetry resource attribute should be configured?
questions.explanation: service.name identifies the logical service. Shared backends use it to distinguish instrumentation from different workloads.
questions.answer: service.name

questions.prompt: An AKS Pod stays Pending with an Insufficient cpu event. Which input affects placement directly?
questions.explanation: The scheduler uses resource requests to choose a node with sufficient allocatable capacity.
questions.answer: Its CPU resource request

questions.prompt: An API has a tunable retrieval limit and a third-party API key. Where should it store each value?
questions.explanation: App Configuration centralizes runtime settings, and Key Vault is designed for secret values and access controls.
options: Retrieval limit in App Configuration and API key in Key Vault
Retrieval limit in a registry password field and API key in Git tags
Both as unencrypted application log properties
questions.answer: Retrieval limit in App Configuration and API key in Key Vault

questions.prompt: Production must pull the exact image tested in staging, even if a tag is moved. What should the deployment reference use?
questions.explanation: A digest identifies specific immutable manifest content. Tags can be reassigned.
questions.answer: The image manifest digest

questions.prompt: A distributed request crosses HTTP and a brokered queue. Which two steps help preserve trace relationships across those boundaries?
questions.explanation: Successful propagation requires metadata insertion by the sender and extraction by the receiver.
options: Set a separate unrelated trace ID at every hop
Extract and use the propagated context when starting downstream spans
Inject the current trace context in outgoing headers or message properties
Put raw credentials in trace context fields
answer: Inject the current trace context in outgoing headers or message properties
Extract and use the propagated context when starting downstream spans

questions.prompt: An application writes a Cosmos DB document and immediately reads it using the same client session. It needs read-your-writes semantics. Which consistency level is designed for this?
questions.explanation: Session consistency provides read-your-writes within a client session via session tokens.
options: Bounded staleness with a long interval
questions.answer: Session

questions.prompt: A worker should stop processing a batch safely during shutdown. In-flight Service Bus messages are under PeekLock. Which policy best prevents lost work?
questions.explanation: Completion confirms a successful result. Unsettled locks can expire and allow unfinished work to be retried.
options: Complete every locked message immediately when shutdown starts
Delete the queue after releasing the locks
Complete messages only after successful work and leave unfinished deliveries available for redelivery
Switch to ReceiveAndDelete just before stopping
questions.answer: Complete messages only after successful work and leave unfinished deliveries available for redelivery

questions.prompt: An ingest job produces an event that both auditing and embedding teams must process independently. Which Service Bus configuration fits?
questions.explanation: A topic gives each subscription its own copy of matching messages.
options: One subscription shared by both teams
One session per team on a single unfiltered queue
A topic with a separate subscription for each team
questions.answer: A topic with a separate subscription for each team

questions.prompt: A KQL query needs the number of requests for every five-minute window. Which pattern fits?
questions.explanation: bin groups timestamps into fixed intervals, and summarize aggregates the events in each group.
questions.answer: summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

questions.prompt: A PostgreSQL migration will store and query embeddings with pgvector. Which statement enables the extension in a database after it is allowed at the server level?
questions.explanation: The package is called pgvector, while the PostgreSQL extension name used in CREATE EXTENSION is vector.
options: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgvector;
questions.answer: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

questions.prompt: A PostgreSQL workload times out under spikes because every web request opens a new connection. Which change addresses connection churn?
questions.explanation: A bounded pool reuses existing connections and caps concurrent database sessions.
options: Open a different connection per SQL statement
Use exact vector scans for all requests
questions.answer: Reuse a bounded connection pool

questions.prompt: A production HNSW index is frequently read from disk, increasing retrieval latency. Which signals help decide whether to provision more memory or speed up storage?
questions.explanation: Index footprint and I/O metrics reveal whether the working set fits available memory and how expensive misses are.
options: Index size, cache behavior, and read I/O latency
The Container Apps ingress traffic weight
The max age of the app certificate
The number of Event Grid event types
questions.answer: Index size, cache behavior, and read I/O latency

questions.prompt: A Python inference image contains an unpinned dependency. Rebuilding the same commit yields different behavior between releases. Which change makes dependency installation reproducible?
questions.explanation: A lock file fixes dependency versions across builds. A stable base image digest can also reduce drift.
options: Pin dependencies in a lock file and install from it during the build
questions.answer: Pin dependencies in a lock file and install from it during the build

questions.prompt: Match each problem with the data-layer response.
questions.explanation: These changes address connection churn, rate limiting, and approximate candidate coverage respectively.
answer: Reuse a bounded connection pool
Respect the service retry delay
Test increasing hnsw.ef_search

questions.prompt: A generated manifest needs three replicas of a stateless API and a controlled rolling image upgrade. Which Kubernetes resource should own the Pods?
questions.explanation: A Deployment manages ReplicaSets, replica counts, and rolling changes to the Pod template.
questions.answer: Deployment

questions.prompt: Match each AKS incident to the first diagnostic.
questions.explanation: These diagnostics follow the failed stage: image fetch, scheduling, or process execution.
options: Inspect node capacity and the Pod memory request
Inspect Pod events for image name, auth, or registry connectivity errors
answer: Inspect Pod events for image name, auth, or registry connectivity errors
Inspect node capacity and the Pod memory request
Inspect the previous container logs

questions.prompt: Match each Service Bus settlement action to its outcome.
questions.explanation: The action tells the broker whether the work succeeded, should be attempted again, or needs investigation.
options: Move an unprocessable message for diagnosis
answer: Remove a successfully processed message
Release the lock for redelivery
Move an unprocessable message for diagnosis

questions.prompt: An AKS Pod is in CrashLoopBackOff immediately after a release. Which two checks can provide direct evidence of the cause?
questions.explanation: Pod status and events reveal failures such as OOM or probe errors. Previous logs can show why the process exited.
options: Inspect events and container status with kubectl describe pod
Inspect the public DNS zone exclusively
List the registry retention policy only
Read logs from the previous container instance
answer: Inspect events and container status with kubectl describe pod
Read logs from the previous container instance

questions.prompt: Support wants to investigate frequent failures of one API without exposing user prompts in telemetry. What should the service record?
questions.explanation: Structured identifiers and redacted errors support correlation while minimizing sensitive data exposure.
options: Vault secret values in every dependency record
Operation identifiers and sanitized error categories
Raw prompts and sensitive account credentials in every exception
Full request bodies in trace baggage
questions.answer: Operation identifiers and sanitized error categories

questions.prompt: A document service wants to notify several independent handlers whenever a document is added. Each handler chooses which notifications to receive and needs no ordered command queue. What fits?
questions.explanation: Event Grid routes notifications to subscribers according to subscription configuration and filters.
options: An Azure Functions timer for each document
A Redis TTL key with the document title
A single Service Bus queue with competing consumers
questions.answer: Event Grid with event subscriptions

questions.prompt: A Service Bus worker sometimes completes the business operation but loses its lock before acknowledging the message. Redelivery must not bill the customer twice. What should the worker do?
questions.explanation: A failed acknowledgment does not undo the side effect. An idempotent operation handles both original and repeated deliveries.
options: Always generate a new charge identifier on retry
Make the billing write idempotent using a stable operation identifier
Use ReceiveAndDelete to handle all failures
questions.answer: Make the billing write idempotent using a stable operation identifier

questions.prompt: Type the Container Apps scaling framework acronym used to scale from Service Bus queue depth.
questions.explanation: KEDA translates external event metrics into scaling decisions.
answer: KEDA
Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling

questions.prompt: Which two design choices let a queue-triggered Container Apps worker authenticate its scaler with managed identity?
questions.explanation: The scaler needs an attached identity and permission to read queue metrics or backlog using the service-specific authorization model.
options: Grant that identity the permissions needed by the scaler on the queue service
Configure a managed identity for the application
Store registry admin credentials in the image
answer: Configure a managed identity for the application
Grant that identity the permissions needed by the scaler on the queue service

questions.prompt: A Service Bus-triggered Function uses managed identity and needs to receive from one queue. Which built-in data role is appropriate?
questions.explanation: Data Receiver grants receive operations. Scope it to the queue or appropriate Service Bus resource.
questions.answer: Azure Service Bus Data Receiver

questions.prompt: A container API is deployed by digest and promoted through staging. Put the release steps in order.
questions.explanation: Staging validates a specific artifact. Promoting its digest ensures production pulls the tested image.
options: Deploy the same approved digest to production
Push the candidate image and capture its digest
Deploy the captured digest to staging
answer: Push the candidate image and capture its digest
Deploy the captured digest to staging
Run smoke tests against staging
Deploy the same approved digest to production

questions.prompt: Order an embedding backfill for a new PostgreSQL model index.
questions.explanation: Separating and validating the new embedding version prevents mixed vector spaces during migration.
options: Generate new embeddings and write them with document metadata
Validate retrieval quality against a reference dataset
Switch retrieval traffic to the validated version
Create storage for the new model's vector dimensions
answer: Create storage for the new model's vector dimensions
Generate new embeddings and write them with document metadata
Validate retrieval quality against a reference dataset
Switch retrieval traffic to the validated version

questions.prompt: An app uses Azure RBAC for Key Vault. It needs to read secret values but should never create or rotate them. Which built-in role fits?
questions.explanation: Secrets User grants read access to secret values. Reader is limited to metadata, and Secrets Officer grants secret management permissions.
questions.answer: Key Vault Secrets User

questions.prompt: Multiple application instances share a Cosmos DB change feed processor. Where does the processor coordinate ownership and track progress?
questions.explanation: The lease container stores ownership and checkpoints for change feed processing ranges.
questions.answer: The lease container

questions.prompt: An embedding service writes a trace_id field to structured logs. Support wants to find all records for one failing request without logging the document text. What should they filter on?
questions.explanation: The trace identifier correlates related logs while keeping document content out of telemetry.
options: The trace identifier from the failed request
The most recent Key Vault credential version
questions.answer: The trace identifier from the failed request

questions.prompt: A Redis cache key for generated search results currently includes only query text. Two tenants may ask the same question. What change avoids cross-tenant reuse?
questions.explanation: Cache identity must include the inputs and authorization scope that affect the returned result.
options: Include tenant and other access-scope identifiers in the key
Use a global key per language
questions.answer: Include tenant and other access-scope identifiers in the key

questions.prompt: An Event Grid webhook can receive duplicate events. What should the handler do before producing a nonrepeatable side effect?
questions.explanation: Event delivery can occur more than once. Source-scoped event identity helps process each logical event once.
options: Reject the first attempt for each event
Accept only events that arrive in timestamp order
Use the event identity within its source scope as a deduplication key
questions.answer: Use the event identity within its source scope as a deduplication key

questions.prompt: A queued transcription operation runs to completion and exits. A new execution should start in response to queued work. What Container Apps resource fits?
questions.explanation: Event-driven jobs create separate executions based on scale rules and are suitable for bounded work.
options: An App Service deployment slot swap
questions.answer: An event-driven Container Apps job

questions.prompt: A message payload contains a large generated document. You want to keep queue messages compact while restricting document access. What should the message carry?
questions.explanation: External payload storage avoids large messages. Authorization should be enforced when the consumer fetches the document.
options: The full encoded document plus all intermediate embeddings
An unrestricted public URL with no expiration
A resource locator and document ID, with the consumer authorized separately
The consumer's account credentials in custom properties
questions.answer: A resource locator and document ID, with the consumer authorized separately

questions.prompt: Which two PostgreSQL design choices help a new multi-tenant RAG service store and retrieve embeddings correctly?
questions.explanation: The vector column enforces shape. Tenant metadata supports scoped retrieval.
options: Use a pgvector column with compatible dimensions
Use cosine distance between vectors from unrelated embedding models
Reuse the same PostgreSQL connection from every thread concurrently
Store tenant metadata and apply a tenant filter
answer: Use a pgvector column with compatible dimensions
Store tenant metadata and apply a tenant filter

questions.prompt: You need to trace a background operation from the API response to a Service Bus consumer log entry. What should the producer propagate?
questions.explanation: Propagated correlation connects related work across the asynchronous boundary.
options: A new unrelated request ID in every hop
A correlation identifier or trace context linked to the original request
questions.answer: A correlation identifier or trace context linked to the original request

questions.prompt: An order sender may retry after a timeout and accidentally send the same order twice. With Service Bus duplicate detection enabled, what value must be reused for each retry within the detection window?
questions.explanation: Service Bus duplicate detection uses the application-assigned MessageId. It is distinct from receiver-side idempotency.
questions.answer: MessageId

questions.prompt: A PostgreSQL network error interrupts an ingestion transaction just before the client receives a response. How can a retry avoid duplicate chunks?
questions.explanation: An idempotent upsert prevents duplicate rows when the original commit may already have succeeded.
options: Generate a fresh key for each retry
Remove the unique constraint and append blindly
Store embeddings only in process memory
Use a stable unique chunk key with an idempotent upsert
questions.answer: Use a stable unique chunk key with an idempotent upsert

questions.prompt: A Python Azure Functions v2 app must declare its HTTP route in code. Which Python decorator is designed for that?
questions.explanation: The route decorator configures the HTTP trigger and route for a function in the Python v2 programming model.
questions.answer: @app.route

questions.prompt: A Redis vector index rejects records from a new embedding model. The configured dimension is 768 and the model outputs 1024 values. What should the migration do?
questions.explanation: The stored and query vector dimensions must match the index schema. A model migration also requires compatible embedding spaces.
options: Create a compatible index and regenerate or redirect embeddings appropriately
Pad the old query text to 1024 characters
questions.answer: Create a compatible index and regenerate or redirect embeddings appropriately

questions.prompt: What standard HTTP header carries the W3C trace identifier and parent span identifier? Type the header name.
questions.explanation: The W3C traceparent header contains the trace ID, parent ID, and trace flags.
answer: traceparent

questions.prompt: An app's recent error rate rose after a deployment. Which two signals directly help investigate the regression?
questions.explanation: Grouping failures helps locate the affected surface. Correlated dependencies and exceptions expose contributing operations.
options: The total number of ACR repository names
The Key Vault soft-delete retention period setting
Correlated dependency and exception telemetry for failed operations
Failed request counts grouped by operation or result code
answer: Failed request counts grouped by operation or result code
Correlated dependency and exception telemetry for failed operations

questions.prompt: An AI API's Redis cache stores generated summaries. A cached item must naturally expire after 10 minutes. Which command sets both value and expiration atomically?
questions.explanation: SET with EX writes the value and defines expiration in seconds in one operation.
options: SET summary-key value followed only by TTL summary-key
questions.answer: SET summary-key value EX 600

questions.prompt: A small validation dataset needs a reference result to measure approximate vector search recall. What should produce the reference?
questions.explanation: Exact distance ranking provides a baseline for evaluating which neighbors approximate search missed.
options: Exact nearest-neighbor search over the same filtered candidate set
An approximate query with a lower search budget
questions.answer: Exact nearest-neighbor search over the same filtered candidate set

questions.prompt: An AKS container is marked OOMKilled during large inference batches. Which change directly addresses this failure mode?
questions.explanation: OOMKilled indicates a memory exhaustion event. Reduce memory use or provide an appropriate memory budget.
options: Change the Service protocol to UDP
Increase the rollout revision history limit
Reduce batch memory usage or increase the container memory limit
questions.answer: Reduce batch memory usage or increase the container memory limit

questions.prompt: Match each requirement to the Azure feature.
questions.explanation: Key Vault stores credentials, labels scope settings, and feature flags control activation.
labels: Separate staging and production values by name
Safely roll out a switchable capability
answer: Key Vault secret
App Configuration label
App Configuration feature flag

questions.prompt: Which two values most directly help diagnose a dead-lettered Service Bus message?
questions.explanation: Dead-letter metadata can describe why delivery stopped or why the handler rejected the message.
options: The number of PostgreSQL connections currently open
answer: DeadLetterReason
DeadLetterErrorDescription

questions.prompt: An application must search indexed JSON embeddings in Azure Managed Redis using metadata and vector similarity. What should be defined before issuing a vector query?
questions.explanation: Redis vector search uses an index schema that describes how to interpret and rank the stored vector field.
options: A search index with the embedding field's vector type, dimensions, and distance metric
questions.answer: A search index with the embedding field's vector type, dimensions, and distance metric

questions.prompt: An AKS process is alive, but temporarily unable to serve requests until its model cache reloads. Which probe should fail while it reloads?
questions.explanation: Failed readiness removes a Pod from normal Service routing while allowing the process to recover.
questions.answer: Readiness probe

questions.prompt: A KQL query should show only Name and DurationMs for failed AppRequests records. Which operator reduces the output to those two columns after filtering?
questions.explanation: project selects output columns, while a preceding where clause handles row filtering.
questions.answer: project Name, DurationMs

questions.prompt: Type the Cosmos DB for NoSQL function name used to compare two vectors in a query.
questions.explanation: VectorDistance evaluates similarity according to the vector policy or query parameters.
answer: VectorDistance

questions.prompt: A KQL query should expose the 20 newest failed requests after applying a failure filter. What clause ranks and limits results in one operation?
questions.explanation: top sorts by the given timestamp and returns the requested number of rows. take alone provides no ordering guarantee.
questions.answer: top 20 by TimeGenerated desc

questions.prompt: An API and its inference worker export OpenTelemetry spans, but the two services appear as independent traces. What should you inspect first?
questions.explanation: The downstream service needs the upstream trace context so its spans can be linked to the same trace.
options: The expiry of Redis result keys
Only the worker's PgVector index type
Trace context propagation across the boundary
questions.answer: Trace context propagation across the boundary

questions.prompt: A worker receives a Service Bus message under PeekLock and hits a temporary dependency error. It wants to release the lock for another delivery now. Which action fits?
questions.explanation: Abandon releases the lock and makes the message available for redelivery.
options: Defer the message and discard the sequence number
questions.answer: Abandon the message

questions.prompt: A managed identity has the Azure resource Reader role on an App Configuration store but cannot retrieve key-values. Which data role should be added for read-only access?
questions.explanation: Azure management-plane Reader does not grant read access to the store's data. App Configuration Data Reader is intended for read-only data access.
questions.answer: App Configuration Data Reader

questions.prompt: Order the usual steps for tracing one API request through a downstream HTTP service.
questions.explanation: Outgoing propagation and incoming extraction preserve the relationship across services before export.
options: Extract the context when the downstream service receives the request
Export the recorded spans for correlated analysis
Start a server span for the incoming API request
Inject the current context into the downstream HTTP request
answer: Start a server span for the incoming API request
Inject the current context into the downstream HTTP request
Extract the context when the downstream service receives the request
Export the recorded spans for correlated analysis

questions.prompt: The service receives document-update notifications and routes only revisions marked urgent to a dedicated handler. The urgency is a field in the event payload. What should it configure?
questions.explanation: The payload field can be evaluated by an advanced subscription filter before the urgent handler is invoked.

caseStudy.title: SignalForge
caseStudy.background: SignalForge publishes document update notifications to Azure Event Grid. An urgent-processing function receives a subset of those events. A separate Azure Service Bus queue carries embedding jobs to workers and retains poison messages for operator review.

options: A Function timer that checks the date only
A Redis cache invalidation by query length
A service-wide registry webhook that reacts to all pushes
An Event Grid advanced filter on the urgency field
questions.answer: An Event Grid advanced filter on the urgency field

questions.prompt: A message for one document has failed many times due to malformed text. The operator wants to inspect it while healthy documents continue processing. What should the application rely on?
questions.explanation: Dead-letter handling isolates unprocessable messages so operators can inspect them without blocking normal flow.

caseStudy.title: SignalForge
caseStudy.background: SignalForge publishes document update notifications to Azure Event Grid. An urgent-processing function receives a subset of those events. A separate Azure Service Bus queue carries embedding jobs to workers and retains poison messages for operator review.

options: Dead-letter routing with a recorded failure reason
Complete the message before logging any evidence
Stop all receivers and replay the entire queue
questions.answer: Dead-letter routing with a recorded failure reason
